title: fix(support): create customer support channels as public

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge A two-argument flip consistent across create, adoption search and the scope docs; only the new channel privacy has no test. 1 note · tests partial −1 · risk medium Creates customer support channels as public (`is_private: false`) and points the orphan-adoption search at `public_channel`, with the bot-scope doc updated to match. The three edits are consistent and safe to merge; nothing in the suite pins either argument. - `conversations.create` now passes `is_private: false` - `findUnrecordedChannel` searches `public_channel` instead of `private_channel` - Bot scope doc lists `channels:manage` and `channels:read` ### Before merge - [ ] **Manual** · Add `channels:manage` and `channels:read` to the Maple Support Slack app and reinstall it - [ ] **Manual** · If the reinstall issues a new token, update `MAPLE_SUPPORT_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` in the prd secret store - [ ] **Manual** · Revisit the landing "Private support channel" pricing line (`apps/landing/messages/en.json:257`), now that channels are public ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · No test pins the channel type the service asks Slack for tests · [`packages/backend/src/services/support/SupportChannelService.ts:208`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/4c2f31d492ae6342143bd3644c736e9e10f01cbd/packages/backend/src/services/support/SupportChannelService.ts#L208) The stub in `SupportChannelService.test.ts` answers `users.conversations` from `world.botChannels` and records `conversations.create` bodies without inspecting `types` or `is_private`, so every test passes with either value and nothing catches a revert to a private channel. The suite already asserts other outgoing arguments (`SupportChannelService.test.ts:223`, `packages/chat-platform/src/connectors/slack/outbound.test.ts:572`), so add one for `is_private: false` and `types: "public_channel"`. ``` Assert the recorded `conversations.create` body has `is_private === false` and that the `users.conversations` call passed `types: "public_channel"`; the test world already records both calls in `world.calls`. ```
What was checked - Adoption still requires `channel.creator === botUserId` and an unrecorded id (`SupportChannelService.ts:216`), so a same-named internal channel is still skipped - `missing_scope` surfaces as `SupportSlackRefusedError`, failing the create with `slackError` on the error (`SupportSlackClient.ts:113`) - No other doc or config in the repo still names `groups:write`/`groups:read` for this bot token
`4c2f31d` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.
